svg.title: Cloudflare, Unikernels & Bare Metal: Life of a Prisma Postgres Query
svg.desc: Four connected tiles trace the path of a Prisma Postgres query: Prisma ORM, Cloudflare Workers for auth and cache, the connection pool that generates SQL, and the Prisma Postgres instance running as a unikernel on bare metal, which is highlighted in the Postgres yellow. Prisma blog cover, 2026 brand.
